messages:
Samir: Short thread to lock owners/timelines from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Need clear backups and abort criteria for the soft-limit rollout.
Anya: I will own profiling + RCA. Plan: take two snapshots per shard (low/high churn) and produce diffs. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: I'll own the soft_limit change and per-model prefix_warmer toggle. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m windows. Abort if p95 latency +20ms or evictions >2x.
Priya: Telemetry owner. I'll add fragmentation_ratio (per-shard) and kv_residency_bytes (per-model). Alert: fragmentation delta >12% for 15m.
Zoe: I'll build an emergency reclaim job (slab_compact) with a toggle requiring 2 approvers. Safety: fail if CPU > 75%. ETA 48h.
Samir: Backups: Zoe backs Anya; Priya backs Javier; Samir backs Priya. Add these to the postmortem checklist.
Anya: Profiling commands (short):
```
kv_snapshot --shard=$SHARD --out=/tmp/kv-$SHARD.snap
kv_diff /tmp/kv-*.snap > /tmp/diff.txt
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2210001111/.
Javier: Config snippet:
```
shard_defaults: { soft_limit_ratio: 0.75, eviction_policy: lru_aggressive }
models: { churny-model: { prefix_warmer: { enabled: false } } }
```
Priya: Runbook steps (short): trigger -> fragmentation >12% OR evictions/sec >150 for 10m; actions -> disable warmers for top 3 models, throttle writers 10%, run slab_compact if needed, escalate after 30m.
Samir: Deadlines: profiling (Anya) Fri EOD; canary config (Javier) tomorrow morning; alerts/dashboard (Priya) Thu EOD; slab_compact toggle (Zoe) 48h. Document PRs must reference the postmortem doc.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "KV OOM followups check-in" 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC  attendees: eng-runtime.
Samir: Thanks all. If the canary triggers abort criteria, run the rollback automation and page oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
